content: Melvin-Koushki reports that Akram Jūdī-Niʿmatī weighs all the evidence in Ibn Turka's writings and concludes that he was effectively a crypto-Shiʿi in personal outlook, though not necessarily in the sectarian sense of the term.
refers_to_primary: Akram Jūdī-Niʿmatī, in Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr (SND), pp.lx-lxiii (per MK fn.156)
